title: Opening Hours
text: Enamel Dental is open Monday to Friday 9:00 to 18:00 and Saturday 9:00 to 14:00. Closed Sundays and public holidays. Arrive ten minutes early.

title: Insurance and Direct Billing
text: We accept most major dental insurance plans. Bring your card and photo ID. Participating insurers are billed directly; other plans are reimbursed within fourteen days.

title: Emergency Care
text: For urgent pain call the clinic. Same-day emergency slots are held at 9:00 and 14:00. Outside hours the voicemail gives the on-call number.

title: Cancellation and No-show Policy
text: Cancel at least 24 hours before the appointment. A late cancellation may incur a 500 INR fee. Repeated no-shows may require prepayment.

title: Payment Plans
text: Interest-free instalments are available above 25,000 INR over three or six months. A 20 percent deposit is required before treatment starts.

title: Parking and Access
text: Two visitor spaces are behind the building. Street parking is free after 18:00. The market car park charges 40 INR per hour. The entrance is step-free.

title: Sedation Dentistry
text: Nitrous oxide and oral sedation are available. A responsible adult must accompany you home. Do not drive for six hours after sedation.

title: Children's Dentistry
text: Children are welcome from their first tooth. The first visit is a lap examination. Fluoride varnish is applied every six months and sealants are offered for molars.

title: Infection Control
text: Instruments are sterilised in a class B autoclave, needles are single-use, and spore testing is weekly. Every pack carries a traceability label.

title: Radiography Safety
text: Digital radiographs use the lowest diagnostic dose with a lead apron and thyroid collar. A panoramic radiograph is repeated every three to five years unless indicated. Tell us if you may be pregnant.

title: Dental Implants
text: A titanium fixture is placed, then a crown after three to six months of healing. Planning uses a CBCT scan. Long-term follow-up is required.

title: Orthodontics and Aligners
text: Clear aligners and fixed braces are available. Treatment starts with a digital scan. Aligners are worn 20 to 22 hours a day; a retainer follows treatment.

title: Tooth Whitening
text: In-chair whitening takes about 60 minutes. Sensitivity for up to 48 hours is common. Avoid tea, coffee and red wine for 24 hours. Not recommended in pregnancy.

title: After an Extraction
text: Bite on the gauze for 30 minutes, do not rinse for 24 hours, and use an ice pack. Eat soft food. Call us if bleeding lasts beyond two hours.

title: Records and Privacy
text: Clinical records are confidential. A copy is released only with written consent or where the law requires it. Portal access uses a one-time code.

title: Your First Appointment
text: The first visit includes a full examination, radiographs if needed, and a written plan. Allow 45 minutes. Bring photo ID and insurance details.

title: Payment Methods
text: We accept cards, UPI and bank transfer. Cash is accepted at the front desk. Receipts are emailed on the same day.

title: Appointment Reminders
text: Reminders are sent 7 days, 2 days and on the morning of the appointment by SMS and email. Reply STOP to opt out of SMS.

title: Late Arrival
text: If you arrive more than 15 minutes late the appointment may be shortened or rescheduled. Please call the front desk if you are delayed.

title: Complaints
text: Raise a concern with the practice manager at the front desk or by email. We acknowledge complaints within two working days and aim to resolve them within ten.

title: Complaint Escalation
text: If a complaint is not resolved within ten working days you may ask for a written review by the clinical director. The review is completed within twenty working days.

title: Accessibility
text: The entrance is step-free, the lift reaches the first floor, and a hearing loop is available in the consultation room. Tell us about any access needs when booking.

title: Interpreters
text: Telephone interpreters are available in Hindi, Marathi, Tamil and Gujarati. Ask at booking so we can schedule a longer appointment.

title: Insurance Claims
text: Claims are submitted with an itemised receipt and treatment codes. Reimbursement usually arrives within fourteen days. Pre-authorisation is required above 50,000 INR.

title: After-hours Emergencies
text: After 18:00 the voicemail gives the on-call number. The on-call service is for urgent pain, bleeding or trauma, not for routine bookings.

title: A Child's First Visit
text: The first paediatric visit is a lap examination with the parent present and takes about twenty minutes. No treatment is performed unless the child is comfortable.

title: Retainers
text: Wear the retainer every night for the first year, then three nights a week. A replacement retainer costs 4,000 INR.

title: Implant Aftercare
text: Do not smoke for two weeks after implant surgery. Rinse with the prescribed mouthwash and attend the review at ten days.

title: Whitening Sensitivity
text: Use the desensitising gel provided for three days after whitening. Avoid very hot or cold drinks while sensitivity lasts.

title: Third-party Record Requests
text: Records are released to a third party only with the patient's written consent, or to a court or regulator where legally required.

title: Marketing Consent
text: Marketing messages are sent only with opt-in consent. Withdraw consent at any time and marketing stops immediately.

title: Data Retention
text: Clinical records are retained for seven years after the last visit, or until age 25 for children, then securely destroyed.

title: The Complete Cancellation Guide
text: This guide explains cancellations in detail. The first section covers why notice matters and how it protects other patients. The second section covers the notice window: cancel at least 24 hours before the appointment so the slot can be rebooked. The third section explains fees and the fourth covers repeated no-shows and prepayment.

title: The Complete Insurance Guide
text: This guide explains insurance. The first section explains participating insurers and direct billing. The second section explains the documents to bring: your insurance card and photo ID. The third section explains reimbursement: claims are reimbursed within fourteen days. The final section covers pre-authorisation for larger treatments.

title: The Complete Privacy Guide
text: This guide explains privacy. The first section explains confidentiality. The second section explains consent: a copy of records is released only with written consent or where the law requires it. The third section explains portal access with a one-time code. The final section explains retention and destruction.

title: Cancellation Policy (2024, superseded)
text: This 2024 policy required 48 hours notice and a 1,000 INR fee for late cancellation. It was replaced in 2026 and is kept for audit only.

title: Cancellation Policy (2026, current)
text: The current policy requires at least 24 hours notice and a 500 INR fee for late cancellation. This policy replaced the 2024 version.

title: Payment Plans (2024, superseded)
text: The 2024 plan offered up to six months with a 10 percent deposit. It was replaced in 2026 and is kept for audit only.

title: Payment Plans (2026, current)
text: The current plan offers three or six months interest-free with a 20 percent deposit. It replaced the 2024 version.
